title: Machine QA
summary: Machine QA declares a starting state for every machine case. An exploratory mission can inherit only as a same-driver chain tail; the entire chain runs alone and reserves every declared host before preparation through mission review. Item and deployment runs isolate the chain automatically. A standalone plan must contain only that chain or use a separate plan or scoped attachment. Nothing inherits after a mission. Older serving releases must be upgraded before retrying mission inheritance.
